legacy_strengths_retained: The legacy issue correctly emphasized execution-stage discipline: award, financing, procurement, construction, energization and commercial operation should not be treated as the same signal.
It correctly identified ESS execution and localization as material July themes.
upgrades_in_official_monthly_brief: Promote BESS platform M&A and project-finance evidence into a capital-asset framing rather than treating ESS mainly as project build-out.
Separate AI/data-center power and grid-connection bottlenecks into their own demand/infrastructure flow.
Explicitly reject EV-to-ESS one-for-one substitution using July EV traction-battery and material-demand growth as counterevidence.
Treat tariffs, tax, safety and grid-connection rules as market-entry and technology-selection variables with precise scope guards.
Apply a stricter SBTL pouch filter: ESS growth is not pouch-film demand unless form factor/customer-program evidence exists.
Use the current governed July universe of 365 canonical cards and current normalized evidence binding rather than inheriting the legacy issue source set.
reason: The five-flow structure explains the 365-card July universe with less overlap and stronger decision relevance. A sixth non-lithium flow would elevate a smaller technology subset to the same level as capital formation, grid demand, production mix, minerals and market-entry rules.
